blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte thanked her supporters on Friday for their continued trust in her even as she faces “many trials.” Duterte made the pronouncement as she met with her supporters who went to the Quezon City Hall of Justice for the scheduled arraignment on the three counts of grave threats filed against her before the Quezon City Regional Trial Court. Her arraignment this Friday was deferred again after the court considered the vice president camp’s pending motions for partial reconsideration ad cautelam as well as their pending petition for certiorari before the Supreme Court.
